item.title: Heavy snowstorm and frigid temperatures prompt flight cancellations and delays
item.description: Hundreds of flights were cancelled or delayed Sunday as Toronto was hit with a blizzard and temperatures so bone-chilling that the city urged residents to stay home and avoid unnecessary travel.

item.title: Museum in Vancouver puts personal failures on display, encouraging people to move on
item.description: VANCOUVER — A dead aloe plant, an old wedding dress that symbolized a failed marriage and a rejection letter for a job application are all exhibits that are part of a display of personal failure at a Vancouver mall.

item.title: Ferry with more than 350 people sinks in the southern Philippines leaving at least 15 dead
item.description: MANILA, Philippines (AP) — A ferry with more than 350 people on board sank during the night early Monday near an island in the southern Philippines and rescuers have saved at least 316 passengers and retrieved 15 bodies, officials said.

item.title: Private jet with 8 aboard crashes on takeoff in Maine, FAA says
